description: What a plan outputs, as data: the closed list of units the execute operators of the same domain do one branch at a time. The unit of a blind agent is one page, one modal, one flow; a table or a module is the same idea for a seed or a backend plan. Every plan operator (<domain>.plan) writes this kind as response/data/units.json and nothing else names a unit: an execute branch carries request.json.unit, which must be an id of a units.json bound as inputs.units (scripts/validate-request.mjs#unitGateErrors). Every unit carries its own goal line, because a unit with no goal is a branch nobody can check. Every unit also carries its tier: `journey` when the mission's done-when journey passes through it, `secondary` when it does not. Verification covers the journey and nothing else — a secondary unit is never dispatched to a verifying operator (scripts/unchecked.mjs#VERIFY_LANES) and is written down as unchecked instead, so nothing is silently skipped and no run verifies every unit to be safe. A secondary unit therefore carries `deferral.reason` and a journey unit carries none; the schema states the shape and the gate that reads the file (scripts/validate-request.mjs#unitsErrors) states that relation, the id uniqueness and the dependsOn resolution.

producedBy.description: The plan operator that wrote the file; the unit gate checks it is an operator whose Outputs include this kind.

goal.description: The one line the execute branch is checked against; the plan's receipt repeats it beside the unit.

inputs.description: Files the unit's execute branch binds beyond the plan itself, branch-relative (response/...) or session-relative (step-N/parallel-M/response/...).

dependsOn.description: Units that must be done before this one runs; each is an id of this file, so the orchestrator orders the fan-out from the plan alone.

reason.description: Why the mission's journey does not pass through this unit, in the plan's own words. It is the one home of that sentence: the ledger line copies it and states it nowhere else.

tier.description: Whether the mission's done-when journey passes through this unit. Absent means journey, so a plan written before this field stays readable and stays fully verified.
